## Pull Request Summary

### What does this PR do?
- [ ] Adds a new urban planning or analysis module
- [ ] Improves Gemma 4 AI prompt engineering / backend endpoint
- [ ] Fixes a bug or UI/UX responsiveness issue
- [ ] Adds tests or improves documentation

### Description of Changes
Briefly describe what was changed, added, or removed.

### Related Issue
Closes #[issue-number]

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's TypeScript and linting standards (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] All unit tests pass cleanly (`npm test`).
- [ ] The application builds without errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have not committed any private API keys or secrets.
- [ ] Provenance badges are properly assigned (no fabricated statistics).
- [ ] Tested on both desktop and mobile viewports.
